title: Volvo FH Custom Built FUPS Compliant Road Train Bullbar #40
description: Volvo FH16 Hi-tensile polished Aluminium Road Train FUPS Bullbar, 76mm tube with 6mm thick wall plus four centre box uprights for maximum cab protection. Custom driving light mounts plus light bar mounts to customer spec. Combination Led indicator repeaters and parking lights mounted in external box uprights. Reversible Road Train signs on polished aluminium plate, plus hinged Oversize Sign. Heavy duty hi-tensile aluminium backing plate with dual tow pins. Additional roo cutters for maximum protection plus provision for radar.
